title: LLM Spend (LiteLLM)
description: LiteLLM's own usage/cost tracking table (LiteLLM_SpendLogs) lives in the shared fakeco Postgres instance under the default schema (see litellm's DATABASE_URL in docker-compose.yml). Speed-annotated per spec: current sim_clock.speed_multiplier is shown alongside spend so a wall-clock $/hour figure can be read against the current sim-speed context.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(spend), 0) AS spend_per_wallclock_hour FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE "startTime" >= now() - interval '1 hour'

panels.title: Current Speed Multiplier (sim_clock)
panels.description: Speed-annotation context for the burn-rate panel: at speed_multiplier > 1, each wall-clock hour represents more sim-hours, so the true 'burn per sim-hour' is spend_per_wallclock_hour / speed_multiplier.

targets.rawSql: SELECT speed_multiplier FROM sim_clock WHERE id = 1
SELECT $__timeGroup("startTime", '5m') AS time, SUM(spend) AS spend FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(total_tokens) AS tokens, SUM(spend) AS spend FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" GROUP BY model ORDER BY spend DESC
